item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 07:30 AM 05 November 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Romblon(Cajidiocan, SanFernando and Magdiwang) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 03:05 PM 04 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthernSamar(Mondragon, SanRoque, Pambujan, LasNavas, LopeDeVega), #Albay(Bacacay, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot) and #Catanduanes(SanAndres) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(SilvinoLobos) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
